regions.text: Variable Frequency Digital Controller for Vibratory Feeder / SDVC31 Series
Open the packing box and check the controller's outward appearance and make sure the controller model is exactly what you ordered.
Connect the Output Power Cable in the packing box to the vibrator's electromagnetic coils.

regions.image_alt: 接线示意图：左侧为输出电源线及两个 Output Pin，中间为导线连接，右侧为振动盘电磁线圈组件；图中标注 Ground Wire (Yellow and Green Dual Color)。
Notice 提示区域前的感叹号警示图标。

regions.text: Make sure the vibrator's electromagnetic coils is connected to the two output pins of the Output Power Cable and the electromagnetic coils is reliably grounded otherwise series security incident may occur.
